run_MAE_ST_test: run the MAE-ST model evaluation on a test dataset using command-line arguments
invoke_main_entry_point: invoke the main entry point that parses args and runs the MAE-ST test pipeline
test_ViT_model: test a Vision Transformer model for video classification using a pre-trained checkpoint
evaluate_finetuned_model: evaluate a fine-tuned MAE-ST model on the Kinetics dataset with configurable batch size
run_distributed_evaluation: run distributed evaluation of the MAE-ST model across multiple GPUs
